eyebrow: Why a plain t-test overstates confidence
code:
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
import statsmodels.api as sm

rho, _ = spearmanr(past_5d_rank, fwd_5d_rank)
X = sm.add_constant(past_5d_rank)
model = sm.OLS(fwd_5d_rank, X).fit(
    cov_type="HAC", cov_kwds={"maxlags": 5}
)
t_stat = model.tvalues[1]  # ≈ -2.4
caption: 5-day windows overlap day to day — HAC standard errors correct for the resulting autocorrelation.
